requirements.title: Actual arguments correspond to dummy arguments by keyword or reduced-list position
requirements.definition: A procedure reference actual argument list establishes actual-to-dummy correspondence by argument keyword or by position in the reduced dummy argument list. The reduced list omits a passed-object dummy argument. One actual argument corresponds to each nonoptional dummy argument, at most one actual corresponds to each optional dummy argument, and every actual corresponds to a dummy argument.

pending.nonoptional-exactly-one-correspondence: Source-control negative omits required dummy b from an explicit-interface call; positive control supplies b=2 and records both assignments. This unnumbered program restriction has no required diagnostic claim.
pending.optional-at-most-one-correspondence: Source-control negative supplies optional dummy opt twice, once positionally and once by keyword; positive control supplies opt once and observes PRESENT(opt) plus value 19.
pending.every-actual-has-dummy: Source-control negative supplies an extra positional actual to a one-dummy procedure; positive control has one actual and observes dummy value 31.

requirements.oracle:
Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans establish distinguished non-default state first, then observe portable single-image properties such as exact integer values, exact character values, PRESENT status, defined pointer-association inquiries, rank and bound inquiry results, and caller-side sentinels after procedure return. Unnumbered program restrictions do not create a required processor diagnostic; negative examples for those facets are source-control material only.

S15.5.2.1-001 argument_association_15_5_2_a fixtures: Generated f2023 fixtures establish non-default sentinels, execute the relevant procedure reference, and assert exact integer, logical, character length/text, allocation, bounds, association, PRESENT-independent, or diagnostic-line properties required by the cited source unit. Each runtime facet has a distinct feature mutation that keeps the program conforming and changes the observed association, correspondence, or allocation effect.
requirements.oracle_limitation:
Source accounting only. This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Diagnostics are not claimed unless a numbered constraint or syntax rule requires them. Undefined association status, undefined definition status, processor-dependent argument-passing mechanisms, storage addresses, descriptor layouts, and coarray/image behavior are not executable oracles here.

S15.5.2.1-001 argument_association_15_5_2_a boundaries: Only single-image source-level argument correspondence and defined association/allocation states are asserted. Undefined pointer association status, coindexed/coarray behavior, processor-dependent forwarded TARGET association, storage addresses, descriptor identity, exact diagnostic wording, and unnumbered restrictions without required diagnostics remain pending or out of scope.
requirements.dependencies: Registered dependencies: clauses 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, and 13 for source form, type compatibility, declaration attributes, designators, array element order, expressions, execution constructs, data transfer, and formatting foundations already present in this suite. Unregistered dependencies retained for future fixtures: later clause 15 optional, pointer, allocatable, procedure, elemental, generic, pure/simple, sequence association, and finalization rules; clause 16 inquiry intrinsics and ISO_FORTRAN_ENV support; clauses 14, 17, 18, and 19 for modules, IEEE support, C interoperability, and association/lifetime state.

accounting.rationale: The note gives an example invocation and is not normative.
